Threat Advisory: Remote Code Execution in Apache Log4j (Log4Shell)

CVE: CVE-2021-44228
Affected Product: log4j-core
Affected Versions: 2.0-beta9 to 2.14.1
Attack Vector: JNDI lookup injection via crafted HTTP header (e.g. User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For)

Threat Advisory: Spring4Shell Remote Code Execution

CVE: CVE-2022-22965
Affected Product: spring-webmvc
Affected Versions: 5.3.0 to 5.3.17
Attack Vector: Malicious ClassLoader manipulation via Spring MVC/WebFlux parameter data-binding
